title: The Variational Quantum Eigensolver: a review of methods and best practices
problem_summary: Comprehensive review of VQE methodology: ansatz design (chemistry-inspired and hardware-efficient), classical optimizers, measurement strategies, and error mitigation, surveying best practices across the field rather than proposing a single new method.

components.family_or_name: review/survey of VQE ansatz, optimizer, and measurement best practices
components.notes: Not a single-method paper -- included in this corpus as a cross-cutting reference for the component taxonomy and method-family boundaries used elsewhere in this corpus.

workflow_composition_notes: Review paper; surveys the component space (ansatz/optimizer/measurement/error-mitigation choices) this corpus's own taxonomy is built to represent, rather than describing one specific workflow.
